diagnostics.message: The secure_baseline module instantiates fifteen analyzer_baseline_* sub-modules whose aws_accessanalyzer_analyzer resources run in ORGANIZATION mode (is_organization is set to true), but the module call has no dependency on :resource.aws_organizations_organization.org in the root module. AWS requires the organization — and its access-analyzer.amazonaws.com service integration — to exist before a type = "ORGANIZATION" analyzer can be created; Terraform would otherwise provision the analyzers in parallel with the organization resource, causing creation failures on a fresh account. The official aws_accessanalyzer_analyzer documentation's Organization Analyzer example requires an explicit depends_on on the organization resource. Since is_organization is passed as a literal into the nested module, a bare depends_on on the module block is the only way to express this ordering; no attribute-reference fix exists.
